name: Show me where
title: Show me where: each change Ask AI made to a page has Show me, which brings that part of the page into view and lights it up

events.shown: You pressed Show me on a change Ask AI made to a page

permissions: reads the changes Ask AI made to a page for you (askai_edits), to find where each one is
touches.remove: Turn the switch askai_show off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and Show me is gone from Ask AI's change lines; to remove it for good revert night 24's commit (rouh/askai_show.py, askai_where in rouh/web/views.py and its route in rouh/project/urls.py, the "show" flag in rouh/askai.py, askShowWhere, askShown and askShowSaid in rouh/static/app/runs.js and .ask-show-said in rouh/static/app.css, showPart in rouh/static/askai/askai.js, this manifest).
